statement.p: Consider the vector field \mathbf{F} \left( x, y, z \right) = x \mathbf{i} + y \mathbf{j} + z \mathbf{k}.
a) Find a function f such that \mathbf{F}= \nabla f and f(0,0,0) =0.

b) Use part a) to compute the work done by F on a particle moving along the curve C given by \mathbf{r} \left( t \right) = \left( 1+ 3 \sin t\right) \mathbf{i} + \left( 1+ \sin^2 t \right) \mathbf{j} + \left( 1+ \sin^3 t \right) \mathbf{k}, \quad 0 \leq t \leq \frac{\pi}{2}.
